title: Cross-Layer Residual Stream Pollution Score: Measuring When Interventions in One Layer Corrupt Another

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Steering vectors are being used for safety interventions. Knowing whether interventions are surgically precise or broadly disruptive is a prerequisite for certifying steering-based safety mechanisms. Clear chain from pollution measurement to deployment trust.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: GPT-2-Small, TransformerLens hooks, cosine similarity computation. Applying a steering vector at one layer and measuring residual stream deviation at subsequent layers is a straightforward loop over hooks. Very accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One model, one layer intervention point, five features, one metric (normalized cosine deviation). The deliverable is a decay/spread curve and a pollution score number. Tight scope with clear deliverable. Fits 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
